adr.title: Verified Player as Single Source of Truth
adr.context: Need to establish canonical data model for player information
adr.decision: Verified Player record is the single source of truth for all player data
alternatives: Database as single source with API layer
rejectedAlternatives: Database first: Adds complexity, not needed at current scale
adr.consequences: All layers consume from Verified Player, data consistency guaranteed

adr.title: Adapter Pattern for Data Sources
adr.context: Multiple data providers with different formats
adr.decision: Use adapter pattern to normalize data from different sources
rejectedAlternatives: Direct scraping: Violates single responsibility, hard to maintain
Unified format: Not realistic for external providers
adr.consequences: New provider integration requires only adapter implementation

adr.title: Layer Separation Architecture
adr.context: Need to separate concerns and enable independent development
adr.decision: Implement strict layer separation with defined interfaces
rejectedAlternatives: Monolithic: Hard to maintain, test, and scale
Microservices: Overkill for current scale, adds complexity
adr.consequences: Each layer can be developed and tested independently
